summary: Casual 1-hand stealth horror! Gather souls with a cute Reaper girl & floof.
description:
Death Antique is a Stealth Horror game in which the protagonist—a grim reaper who has lost her scythe—must gather souls from graveyards at night. Enjoy a bit of fortune telling as you watch the story's mysteries unfold in a special place caught between the earth below and the starry sky above.

◆A thrilling, yet floofy game that can be played with one hand!
Hide behind gravestones to avoid the gaze of the prowling dead, grabbing souls as they flee. Even if you're frightened, your trusty dog-shaped Floof is there to calm your fears. A few pets and you'll be good as new! Floof can also turn into a giant Floof Wall to make you invincible, and should you fail, a Retry Fortune Card may help you turn the tables.

◆Play card games between harvests!
Welcome nightly visitors with four different simple, yet tricky card games. The more games you win, the more you'll be able to power up your Floof!

◆An intricate story that weaves a tale of stars and destiny
On one side is the protagonist, who is duty bound to gather souls for the night sky. On the other is a fortune teller, who works with cards in a dark alleyway. As these two stories of heaven and earth come together, the veil lifts, revealing the mysteries within and capturing your heart like a well-told fortune.

◆Recommended for the following people, floof:
-Those who like casual games you can play with one hand
-Those who like the idea of Stealth Horror but don't like things that are too scary
-Those who love the night
-Those who want to pet a floofy creature
-Those who are interested in or liked SleepingMuseum's previous games: Terasene and Matsuro/Death Palette
